component.name: Flatsonar
component.summary: Open-source Flatpak apps, hunted from everywhere

description.p: Flatsonar finds open-source Flatpak apps wherever they live: Flathub, GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, project-hosted remotes and release bundles, and puts them in one store. Every listing credits the original creators and links a way to support them.

You can install anything. Flatsonar reads each app's sandbox permissions and runs a local ClamAV scan before deploying. If something looks dangerous it warns you and asks you to press Sure twice. After that, it's your call.
